verdict.rationale: Snyk's docs say users can "see the issues in the PR if you are using the inline comments capability" (snyk-docs-50). They also document GitHub and GitLab SCM integrations (snyk-intdir-3, snyk-intdir-4) and scanning "across IDEs, repositories, and CI/CD pipelines" (snyk-docs-26, snyk-docs-31). However, the PR-comment evidence is a single passing mention in a Broker configuration page, and nothing describes PR status checks or how findings appear in GitHub versus GitLab. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of PR status checks and inline PR comments, explicit confirmation for both GitHub and GitLab, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
